The '''Mining Guild''', located in and beneath [[Falador]], is a guild for expert miners available to players with at least 60 [[Mining]] (can be [[Temporary skill boost#Mining|boosted]]). The [[List of mines|mine]] is accessible from either the Mining Guild's above-ground complex in the south-east of the city, or through the gate at the southern end of the [[Dwarven Mine]]. Both of these entrances are guarded by [[Dwarf (Mining Guild)|dwarves]] who will answer questions about the guild and stop players without the requirements from entering the guild. The guildmaster, [[Gadrin]], also sells the [[Mining cape]] to those who have achieved level 99 Mining.

This [[List of mines|mine]] is one of many where three iron rocks can be mined without moving, thus ideal for [[Iron rocks#Power-mining Locations|power-mining]].
